comments.body: I would have your mutual friend (or the person that invited you) introduce you to them. From there conversations naturally form. If they don't, simply then ask if you can "join" their conversation or if you can hear on it. After a few minutes, once you got a good idea what the conversation is about you should start to be able to pitch in and give your opinions and contribute to that conversation. And your are in! That's the way I usually do it with Swiss people honestly, and by extension most "germanic" cultured people and it usually works quite well
comments.author: ThorusBonus
